title: Zinkan Enterprises
description: zinkanenterprises.com Zinkan Enterprises is a private US environmental services company founded in 1983 in Hunt Valley, Ohio, operating in water treatment, pond and lake management, oil and gas chemicals and waste management. With 45 to 75 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it owns several brands including Pace Products, the creator of Freeze Free, the world's first anti-freeze pond coating dating back to the 1960s. Its Crystal Clear division manages ponds and water features for prestigious clients including Walt Disney World golf courses and the 2006 Open Championship at Royal Liverpool. Led by founder Thomas Zinkan, the company offers full-cycle solutions from chemical products to fountain equipment and contract pond maintenance. Core strengths are 42 years of experience, a unique patented anti-freeze technology and diversified revenue across four environmental service verticals.
